verdict.rationale: Helicone's docs and GitHub describe automatic, one-line logging of every LLM request across providers. Sessions trace multi-step agent flows end to end in one view. Community users confirm it shows the final prompt sent, its cost, and charts and logging for debugging. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that latency and token usage are captured per request, and explicit description of logged input/output payload fields (these are only implied by request logging and cost tracking).
